# WarpMap { #timetoalign.alignment.WarpMap }

```python
alignment.WarpMap(
    source_timeline_id,
    target_timeline_id,
    interpolation_map,
    source_unit,
    target_unit,
    source_number_type,
    target_number_type,
)
```

Bidirectional coordinate warping derived from alignment data.

A WarpMap converts coordinates from a *source* timeline to a *target*
timeline (and back) using linear interpolation between anchor points
extracted from a `timetoalign.MatchLine`.

Internally it delegates to an `timetoalign.maps.interpolation.InterpolationMap`
for O(log n) lookup.  The ``materialise()`` method produces a complete
copy of a source `timetoalign.Timeline` with all coordinates warped
to the target's coordinate space.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name               | Type                                                                  | Description                                                |
|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
| source_timeline_id | [str](`str`)                                                          | ID of the source timeline.                                 |
| target_timeline_id | [str](`str`)                                                          | ID of the target timeline.                                 |
| interpolation_map  | [InterpolationMap](`timetoalign.maps.interpolation.InterpolationMap`) | The underlying InterpolationMap for coordinate conversion. |
| source_unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)                         | Canonical unit of the source timeline.                     |
| target_unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)                         | Canonical unit of the target timeline.                     |
| source_number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`)                     | Canonical source-axis number type.                         |
| target_number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`)                     | Canonical target-axis number type.                         |
| n_anchors          | [int](`int`)                                                          | Number of anchor points used for interpolation.            |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> warp = WarpMap.from_match_line(match_line, "audio")
>>> warp.get_coordinate_at(100.0, format="float")
45.5
>>> warp.inverse().get_coordinate_at(45.5, format="float")
100.0
```

### from_coordinate_pairs { #timetoalign.alignment.WarpMap.from_coordinate_pairs }

```python
alignment.WarpMap.from_coordinate_pairs(
    source_timeline_id,
    target_timeline_id,
    source_coords,
    target_coords=None,
    *,
    source_unit=None,
    target_unit=None,
    source_number_type=None,
    target_number_type=None,
)
```

Build a WarpMap from typed coordinate pairs or alignment anchors.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type                                                                                                                                                          | Description                                                                                                                                    | Default    |
|--------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| source_timeline_id | [str](`str`)                                                                                                                                                  | ID of the source timeline.                                                                                                                     | _required_ |
| target_timeline_id | [str](`str`)                                                                                                                                                  | ID of the target timeline.                                                                                                                     | _required_ |
| source_coords      | [list](`list`)\[[IdCoordinate](`timetoalign.core.time.IdCoordinate`)\] \| [list](`list`)\[[AlignmentAnchor](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.AlignmentAnchor`)\] | Source ``IdCoordinate`` values, or complete ``AlignmentAnchor`` values. Duplicate sources are averaged only when their targets are compatible. | _required_ |
| target_coords      | [list](`list`)\[[IdCoordinate](`timetoalign.core.time.IdCoordinate`)\] \| None                                                                                | Target ``IdCoordinate`` values when separate source coordinates are supplied; omitted for anchors.                                             | `None`     |
| source_unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) \| None                                                                                                         | Explicit source unit validator or inferred anchor unit.                                                                                        | `None`     |
| target_unit        | [TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`) \| None                                                                                                         | Explicit target unit validator or inferred anchor unit.                                                                                        | `None`     |
| source_number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`) \| None                                                                                                     | Explicit source representation validator or inferred homogeneous anchor representation.                                                        | `None`     |
| target_number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`) \| None                                                                                                     | Explicit target representation validator or inferred homogeneous anchor representation.                                                        | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type        | Description    |
|--------|-------------|----------------|
|        | \'WarpMap\' | A new WarpMap. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                          |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [TypeError](`TypeError`)   | If coordinate lists use unsupported or mixed scalar forms.                                                                                                           |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If fewer than two pairs exist, typed identities or axis metadata conflict, source values are ambiguous, or remaining source coordinates are not strictly increasing. |

### from_match_line { #timetoalign.alignment.WarpMap.from_match_line }

```python
alignment.WarpMap.from_match_line(
    match_line,
    target_timeline_id,
    *,
    source_unit=None,
    target_unit=None,
    source_number_type=None,
    target_number_type=None,
)
```

Build a WarpMap from a MatchLine's coordinate pairs.

Extracts ``(source_coord, target_coord)`` pairs from the
MatchLine for the given target timeline, deduplicates compatible
chord coordinates, and constructs the interpolation map. A repeated
source coordinate with materially different targets is rejected.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name               | Type                                                      | Description                                          | Default    |
|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| match_line         | \'MatchLine\'                                             | The MatchLine providing ordered stamps.              | _required_ |
| target_timeline_id | [str](`str`)                                              | The target timeline to warp towards.                 | _required_ |
| source_unit        | \'TimeUnit \| None\'                                      | Explicit source unit, which must match every anchor. | `None`     |
| target_unit        | \'TimeUnit \| None\'                                      | Explicit target unit, which must match every anchor. | `None`     |
| source_number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`) \| None | Explicit canonical source representation.            | `None`     |
| target_number_type | [NumberType](`timetoalign.core.enums.NumberType`) \| None | Explicit canonical target representation.            | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type        | Description    |
|--------|-------------|----------------|
|        | \'WarpMap\' | A new WarpMap. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                           |
|--------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If fewer than 2 coordinate pairs are available.                       |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If ``target_timeline_id`` is not in the MatchLine's target timelines. |

### materialise { #timetoalign.alignment.WarpMap.materialise }

```python
alignment.WarpMap.materialise(source_timeline)
```

Produce a new Timeline with all contents warped to target coordinates.

Creates a complete copy of the source timeline where every
coordinate (events, children, regions) is converted by calling this
map. The resulting timeline:

- Has length equal to the mapped ``source_timeline.length``
- Preserves the source's unit (unless ``target_unit`` differs)
- Contains warped copies of all events
- Contains warped copies of all children (recursively)
- Contains warped copies of all regions
- Carries an inverse WarpMap as a ConversionMap for traceability

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type         | Description           | Default    |
|-----------------|--------------|-----------------------|------------|
| source_timeline | \'Timeline\' | The timeline to warp. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                             |
|--------|--------------|-----------------------------------------|
|        | \'Timeline\' | A new Timeline with warped coordinates. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                                       | Description                                                                                                                                     |
|--------|--------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`)                 | If ``source_timeline.id`` does not match ``self.source_timeline_id``.                                                                           |
|        | [UnknownLengthError](`UnknownLengthError`) | If the length of the source timeline or of any of its descendants is unknown: its extent can be neither checked against the support nor warped. |
